notes: The agent was assigned a vaguely-defined task ('User board for braydon — persistent conversation surface') with zero acceptance criteria and no clear specification of the deliverable. The agent spent ~2 minutes checking prerequisites (found paia-events responding, Supernote directory missing) and fixing a contract violation (auto_followups = false), then marked the task as done without producing any artifacts or deliverable. The FLIP verification failed (0.45 vs 0.70 threshold), which strongly signals incomplete work. Critical failures: (1) no artifacts recorded despite the task asking for a 'persistent conversation surface'; (2) task marked done without resolving the missing Supernote prerequisite or building the actual interface; (3) no handoff of usable output to downstream tasks. The agent followed workgraph conventions and documented findings clearly in the task log, earning partial credit for coordination. However, the core objective—delivering a user board—was not addressed. The underspecified acceptance criteria made the task ambiguous, but the agent should have either flagged this as blocking or produced a reasonable interpretation of the requirement. This work is below expectations and would require significant rework to be useful.
